units.source_text: 夕雾与云居雁同在太君膝下长大起来，十岁之后，两人分居异室。

en.t: Yugiri and Kumoi no Kari grew up together under the care of the grand lady; after they turned ten, the two were made to live in separate rooms.

units.source_text: 内大臣教训云居雁道：“夕雾表弟和你虽是近亲，但为女子者，对男子不可过分接近。”

en.t: The Minister of the Interior admonished Kumoi no Kari, saying, "Although your cousin Yugiri is a close relative, a girl must not become too intimate with a boy."

units.source_text: 两人分开以后，夕雾的童心也未免恋慕云居雁，每逢观赏樱花、红叶之时，或一同戏耍玩偶之时，夕雾必然紧紧追随她，对她表示好感。

en.t: After the two were separated, Yugiri's childish heart could not help longing for Kumoi no Kari; whenever they admired cherry blossoms or autumn leaves, or played with dolls together, Yugiri would always follow close beside her and show his affection.

units.source_text: 云居雁自然也爱慕夕雾，直到如今，相见时还是两小无猜，不知回避。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari naturally loved Yugiri as well, and even now, when they met, they were still innocent childhood companions who did not know to avoid each other.

units.source_text: 侍候他们的侍女、乳母等在旁议论：“有什么关系呢？

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting and nurses who attended them discussed it nearby, saying, "What harm is there in it?

units.source_text: 两人都还是孩子，况且多年相伴，一块儿长大起来，突然把他们拆开，未免太忍心吧。”

en.t: They are both still children, and besides, they have been together for years and grown up side by side. To separate them so suddenly is surely too cruel."

units.source_text: 云居雁无心无思，一味天真烂漫。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari had no hidden thoughts and was simply innocent and carefree.

units.source_text: 夕雾虽然还是个幼稚的孩童，似乎情窦未开，但不知和她发生了什么关系，自从离居以来，一直忧愁叹息，心绪不宁。

en.t: Although Yugiri was still an immature child and seemed not yet awakened to love, something had clearly happened between him and her, for ever since they began living apart he had been constantly sorrowful, sighing, and restless at heart.

units.source_text: 他们的书法还很生硬，然而也颇美观，将来显然是很出色的。

en.t: Their calligraphy was still rather stiff, yet it was already quite pleasing, and it was clear that it would become excellent in the future.
So the two began exchanging love letters.

units.source_text: 但儿童粗心大意，有时不免随处散落。

en.t: But children are careless, and at times the letters inevitably ended up scattered here and there.

units.source_text: 侍女们拾得了，约略知道了他们的关系。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting picked them up and came to know roughly what was going on between the two.
Yet who would tell anyone else?
They all simply pretended not to have seen anything.
